title: TradingView Visual Oracle — canonical per-bar trace (v1.1.0)
description:
The versioned parity interface between the Python engine and the Pine oracle. One record per DETECTION bar, with a nested per-execution-bar section. Produced by an OFFLINE parity runner that derives from already-computed frames — it must never alter a production decision. See docs/tradingview_visual_oracle_parity_audit.md section 17 for why derivation is preferred over instrumenting the live loop.

CHANGELOG 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 (Stage S1): the trace became STAGE-SCOPED. `header.stage` and `header.sections_implemented` were added, and `detection_bar.structure` moved from required to optional. Rationale: S1 implements data/time/session only, and requiring a `structure` block would have forced fabricated placeholder values into every S1 row — indistinguishable from implemented parity, which the design forbids. A section that is absent is UNIMPLEMENTED; a section that is present is COMPARED. Also added: `utc_day`, session transition fields, `bar_completeness`, and `data_context`.

stage.description: The highest parity stage this trace covers, e.g. 'S1'.

sections_implemented.description: Which per-bar sections carry real values. A comparator MUST ignore any section not listed here rather than treating its absence as a mismatch.

sections_unimplemented.description: Explicitly declared as not yet produced. Present for readability; `sections_implemented` is authoritative.

environment_provenance.description: Recorded, never hashed. Dependency versions have measurably moved governed floats (~220 ULP bbw_value between hosts). Used only during divergence triage.

warmup_excluded_bars.description: Leading bars excluded from scoring because history-seeded values have not converged. Comparison MUST honour these.

field_class.description: Comparison discipline. exact = zero tolerance, any difference fails. price = compared within the fixture's price tolerance. normalized = compared after canonicalisation (case/whitespace/ordering). feed = expected to differ between data providers; divergence is recorded, not failed. python_only = has no Pine counterpart and is never compared. pine_unavailable = Pine cannot compute it at all; presence in Pine output is itself an error.

detection_bar.description: `structure` and every later-stage section are OPTIONAL and are absent — not null, not zero — until their stage is implemented. See header.sections_implemented.

bar_epoch_ms.description: UTC bar-open as epoch milliseconds — the form Pine's `time` gives, so the comparator can match without string parsing. class: exact

bar_index.description: Position in the canonical dataset, NOT a time grid — missing intervals are dropped. class: python_only (compare index DELTAS, never absolute values; limitation L-09)

bar_completeness.description: Production only ever admits CLOSED bars (MT5BarBridge.closed_m1_bars); an offline trace over a stored file is always 'closed'. Pine must gate on barstate.isconfirmed to match. class: exact

utc_day.description: Production UTC calendar day (strategy_core.regime.utc_date_key). NOT an exchange session day — limitation L-06.

day_transition.description: True on the first bar of a new UTC day. class: exact

data_context.description: Whether this bar is inside the oracle's supported context.

volume.description: Never used in any decision. class: feed

parsed.description: The volatility flip that decides OB bounds (limitation L-03).

atr_rma_200.description: First-value seeded RMA, NOT ta.atr. class: price

session.description: Assigned by strategy_core.sessions from the UTC HOUR of the bar-open timestamp, window [start, end). No DST, no weekday, no exchange session.

code.description: Generated stable numeric code for the key (contract-derived), so Pine can PLOT it for comparison instead of relying on colour. class: exact

window_start_hour.description: null for the Outside fallback. class: exact

window_end_hour.description: EXCLUSIVE. null for Outside. class: exact

is_fallback.description: True when no window matched and Outside was used. class: exact

prev_key.description: Session of the PREVIOUS bar in this trace, not of the previous clock hour. class: exact

transition.description: True when key != prev_key. class: exact

transition_reason.description: first_bar = no previous bar in the window. gap_resync = the previous bar was more than one timeframe step earlier, so the change may hide unobserved sessions. class: exact

market_state.description: Leakage-safe daily panel row for this bar's UTC date, already shifted one day (limitation L-06).

swing_trend_bias.description: Never reset; history-seeded (limitation L-04). class: exact

structure_event.description: Both a bull and a bear event can fire on one bar; when they do, BULL is emitted first. class: exact

s2.description: Stage S2 — volatility and parsed prices. Mirrors _true_range, _pine_rma(200) and _add_parsed_prices. NOTE: parsed prices are consumed ONLY by _make_order_block (S5); they do NOT feed swings or breaks.

high_close.description: null on bar 0 (no previous close). class: price

true_range.description: Bar 0 resolves to high-low: production takes a row-wise max over three columns and pandas skips NaN. class: price

rma_prev.description: The RMA's previous value — lets a comparator locate a divergence at the bar it began rather than after it compounds. class: price

atr.description: FIRST-VALUE seeded RMA, alpha = 1/200. NOT ta.atr/ta.rma, which seed with an SMA. class: price

cumulative_mean_range.description: tr.cumsum()/max(index,1) — index 0 AND 1 both divide by 1. Only used when ob_filter != 'Atr'. class: price

parsed_high.description: SWAPPED with parsed_low when high_volatility. class: price

atr_warm.description: True while fewer than 200 bars have been seen. class: exact

s3.description: Stage S3 — the INLINED swing loop inside detect_order_blocks. strategy_core/swings.py::detect_swings is dead on the live path and is NOT mirrored. Reads RAW high/low, never parsed prices.

warmup.description: True for bars before swing_length; production's loop never reaches them. Structure fields are ABSENT, not zero. class: exact

right_window_max_high.description: max over bars [pivot+1, i] INCLUSIVE — exactly swing_length bars. class: price

new_leg_high.description: pivot high STRICTLY > window max. class: exact

leg_change.description: A swing is recorded only on a TRANSITION. class: exact

swing_high_level.description: The single most-recent uncrossed swing high. class: price

swing_high_crossed.description: Latches; a swing breaks once. class: exact

swing_high_seq.description: ORACLE-side monotonic label. Production has no swing id — it keeps one dict per side. Used only to line the two traces up. class: normalized

s4.description: Stage S4 — BOS/CHoCH from a two-bar RAW CLOSE test. Bull is evaluated FIRST; both blocks are independent ifs, so both can fire on one bar and the order is part of the behaviour.

swing_trend_bias.description: 0 until the first break, then BULLISH(1)/BEARISH(-1). NEVER reset — seeded by the first break in LOADED history (limitation L-04). class: exact

events.description: In production evaluation order: bullish first, then bearish.

tag.description: CHoCH only when flipping from the OPPOSITE bias; bias 0 yields BOS, so the first break of a run is always BOS. class: exact

obs_created.description: Order blocks created on THIS bar, in production append order. NOT produced before Stage S5.

active_ob_ids.description: class: python_only — match by (detection_time, direction, top, bottom), never by id (limitation L-05)

execution_bars.description: The 1m candles inside this detection bar that changed candidate or lifecycle state. Bars with no state change MAY be omitted; omission is not a difference.

s5.description: Stage S5 — order-block CREATION only. Mirrors `_make_order_block`, `_ob_width_pips` and `_passes_size_filter`. No mitigation, invalidation, expiry or retirement: production assigns no lifecycle state at creation, so creation is separable and stops here.

warmup.description: True before swing_length; production's loop never reaches these bars. Fields are ABSENT, not zero.

next_ob_id.description: Counter state AFTER this bar. class: python_only

active_ob_count.description: Order blocks created so far. Nothing is ever removed. class: python_only

inventory_checksum.description: Running total of round(top*1e5)+round(bottom*1e5) over every ACCEPTED block so far. A bounded, exactly-reproducible summary of the whole inventory: neither ob_id (L-05) nor bar_index (L-09) can be compared across feeds, but this can. class: exact

s6.description: Stage S6 — the UTC daily regime panel. Mirrors strategy_core/regime.py::daily_regime_panel AS REACHED IN PRODUCTION, i.e. through scripts/run_backtest.py::_portfolio_panel_index. The global regime gate (`regime_gate_enabled`) is FALSE and `regime_emit_for_run` returns None, so mirroring THAT path would reproduce dead code; the panel is live via the portfolio policy (mode `enforce`) and the state-target policy. Values are those of the LAST COMPLETED UTC day and are constant across every intraday bar of the current day.

warmup.description: No prior COMPLETED day, or an indicator is not yet valid. Fields are null, never zero.

day_key.description: UTC calendar day of THIS bar. class: exact

source_day.description: The completed day the state was classified from — the one-day shift. class: exact

day_index.description: 0-based index into the chart's daily series. class: python_only

daily_bars.description: Intraday bars aggregated into that day. Feed-dependent (L-02). class: normalized

ema.description: EMA(200) of daily closes, FIRST-VALUE seeded (ewm adjust=False). NOT ta.ema. class: price

px_vs_ema.description: (close-ema)/ema*100. Exactly 0 classifies BEAR — the operator is `> 0`. class: price

bb_sd.description: SAMPLE deviation, ddof=1. ta.stdev is a POPULATION deviation, differing by sqrt(n/(n-1)). class: price

bbw_above.description: `bbw > threshold` — equality is COMPRESS. class: exact

adx.description: Wilder, smoothed with the same first-value-seeded ewm at alpha=1/14. NOT ta.adx. class: price

adx_is_chop.description: `adx < chop` — equality is TREND. class: exact

volatility_state.description: Still reported on a Chop row: the ADX test overrides the state NAME, not this field. class: exact

validity.description: `warmup` and `invalid` are DISTINCT: the first is 'not enough daily history', the second is 'the classifier refused'. class: exact

replay_unattainable.description: Always true. The chart's daily series is ~226 days; production seeds EMA(200) in 2015 and it never converges. class: exact

crossed.description: Latches; a swing breaks once. class: exact

top.description: origin parsed_high; may be BELOW bottom on a flipped high-volatility origin. class: price

rejected_reason.description: Present when the OB or its plan was rejected and NO trade row exists. These are invisible in the trades CSV and must be derived. class: exact

bar_index_delta.description: Offset from this candidate's trigger bar. Compared instead of the absolute index (limitation L-09). class: exact

ob_ref.description: Identity of the OB this record concerns, by content not id.

block_reasons.description: ORDERED in production evaluation order (audit section 7). The FIRST entry is the authoritative one; later entries are informational. Order is part of the comparison. class: exact

session_key.description: From the FILL candle, not the detection candle. class: exact

portfolio_regime_effective.description: Post with_disabled_as_label. This is what the walk uses. class: exact

protection.description: INERT under the deployed config (protection_modes=['baseline']). Present so a future activation is visible as a schema-populated field rather than a silent behaviour change.

break_even.description: INERT under the deployed config (be_enabled=false, no cohort be/risk_reduction).

pnl_r.description: Fixed -1.0 or rr_multiple, never derived from exit price. class: exact

transition_events.description: Catalogue names from audit section 15. class: exact

limitation_flags.description: Limitation IDs that apply to this record — e.g. NEWS-UNAVAILABLE marks a row that MUST be excluded from parity scoring, INTRA-WINDOW marks a fill+exit inside one 15m window. class: exact

python_only.description: Recorded for triage, never compared: state Pine has no access to.

ob_candidate.description: ONE order-block candidate, recorded whether or not it was appended. Production builds the dict, assigns the CURRENT ob_id into it, then runs the size gate, and increments the counter only inside the accept branch — so a rejected candidate leaves no trace in the output frame at all. It is captured here because 'why is there no box on this break' is otherwise unanswerable, and because the id sequence is only verifiable if the rejections are visible.

event_index.description: Order WITHIN the bar. Bullish is evaluated first and both branches are independent `if`s, so a bar can carry two candidates and the order is behaviour. class: exact

tag.description: From the bias ENTERING the break. A same-bar bull break flips the bias before the bear branch reads it, so the second candidate can be CHoCH from a bias that did not exist when the bar opened. class: exact

pivot_price.description: RAW swing level; equals break_level. class: price

break_close.description: The close that crossed it. class: price

origin_index.description: Bar the BOX is taken from: the extreme parsed price over [pivot_index, break_index-1], EARLIEST on a tie. null when the search window was empty. class: python_only

proposed_top.description: origin parsed_high — may be BELOW bottom on a high-volatility origin. class: price

proposed_width_pips.description: abs(top-bottom)/pip_size — abs() keeps an inverted box positive. class: price

size_gate_passed.description: BOTH comparisons are strict, so the gate is INCLUSIVE at both boundaries: a width of exactly max_pips passes. class: exact

ob_id.description: Assigned ONLY on append; null when rejected, and the next accepted block reuses the integer. Dense 1..N over accepted blocks. Counted from the first bar of LOADED history, so a chart's ids will not equal production's (limitation L-05) — match on (detection_time, direction, top, bottom). class: python_only

active.description: Production has NO active flag at creation: membership in the list IS admission. True for appended, false for rejected. class: exact
